newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa to close blast furnace for repairs.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa to close blast furnace for repairs.

text.p: Mexican steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) will shut down one of its blast furnaces for 62 days for repairs, the company said on Tuesday.
Blast furnace No. 4 is Ahmsa's second largest furnace with a production capacity of 2,200 tonnes of liquid steel per day, and was built in 1971, a company statement said.
The company said Ahmsa's overall production would not suffer as blast furnace No. 2, currently under repair, was scheduled to come back on stream in June.
"Current reconditioning guarantees full capacity to meet production targets set by the company," Ahmsa said.
